themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street Condition complaints spiked to 124 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 26.9 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 361% increase (z-score: 11.28)—suggesting rapid pavement or infrastructure failure across CD 401 requiring immediate investigation into root cause and scope.

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Surge in Parks
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints jumped 673% to 29 THIS WEEK versus 3.8 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.01), coinciding with a 10,300% spike in Park Rules violations (13 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 avg) and 2,300% spike in Park Noise complaints, indicating emerging disorder or uncontrolled activity in district parks.

themes_detail.label: Homeless Services Demand Surge
themes_detail.summary: Homeless Person Assistance complaints spiked 433% to 36 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO versus 6.8 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.02), aligning with repeated community board budget requests for homeless shelters and improved shelter safety, suggesting crisis-level demand for services.

reporting_angles: Interview DHS about current shelter capacity in Astoria/LIC; investigate whether recent spike is weather-driven or reflects systemic undersupply
